---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

#### [How does my step count vary during the school year?]{.underline}

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
step_count <- read_csv("pvj_data.csv")

step_count <- step_count |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
       steps = as.numeric(steps)) |>
  mutate(day_of_week = wday(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) |>
  select(date, day_of_week, steps) |> 
  filter(!is.na(steps)) |> 
  mutate(day_type = if_else(day_of_week %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"),
                            "Weekend", "Weekday"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(step_count, aes(x = steps)) +
  geom_histogram(color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Number of Steps", x = "Steps", y = "Count")
```

```{r}
ggplot(step_count, aes(x = day_of_week, y = steps)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Steps by Day of the Week", 
       x = "Day of Week", 
       y = "Steps")
```

```{r}
ggplot(step_count, aes(x = date, y = steps, color = day_type)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Weekend" = "blue", 
                              "Weekday" = "orange")) +
  labs(subtitle = "I walk less as the weather gets colder and am more likely to walk less on the weekends.",
       title = "Daily Step Counts Over Time by Type of Day",
       x = NULL, 
       y = NULL, 
       color = "Type of Day",
       caption = "Author: Lindsay Edmonson | Date: November 18th, 2026 | Data Source: Personal Apple Health Export") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 0.001, suffix = "k"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

> From the last plot, I observed that in general I walked a lot less on Sundays than I did any other day.
> I tended to walk more in August than I did in September and October, probably because August was still summer break and I had more free time than I do now in the school year.
